item.title: Basic guide to Linux customization
item.description: If you know a little bit about Linux and you’ve used the command line and package managers before but haven’t really gotten into customizing your system, then this article might be for you. Firstly, on the choice of distribution, I’m currently running Ubuntu 24 and I distro-hopped to Arch and Fedora a bunch before settling on it and, to be honest, I’m yet to find a truly meaningful difference between distros.
